description: Hobby+ endpoint. Fair price of a parlay across games (2-15 legs), from the same no-vig fair lines as propline_get_event_ev. Returns fair_price for the parlay, each leg's fair_price and best price + book, best_legs_price, books (every book that prices all the legs: the product of its leg prices, with ev_pct), and offered_ev_pct when price is given. The fair price ASSUMES INDEPENDENT LEGS: legs on the same event are flagged same_game — say so, and use propline_price_sgp for same-game parlays. A leg that matches no fair line returns a reason and the parlay is not priced. Never present the EV as a profit guarantee.

selection.description: Team, player, or Over/Under for a game total.
